description: The reader has finished only Chapter I and asks how the book ends. Muse must keep the ending hidden and offer reflection within the chapter they have read.

input.reader_message: I'm only through the first chapter. Does Alice ever make it back home in the end, or is she stuck down there?

librarian_evidence: In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.

criteria: declines to reveal how the book ends
uses only Chapter I material, if any book detail at all
turns the uncertainty into a reflective invitation rather than a flat refusal
